title: Nothing's Shocking
summary: One of the most influential albums in my life. Changed me. Not just because it had boobs, lyrics, bass, drums, licks, and vocals...Just spot on.... Spoke to middle school me.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2q0jl6mL-VA&list=PL6ogdCG3tAWj78lwIVHjSU9pqYwa1KM9b&index=3

One of the most influential albums in my life. Changed me. Not just because it had boobs, lyrics, bass, drums, licks, and vocals...Just spot on....

Spoke to middle school me.
